profile.industry: Cultural Living Heritage & Direct Artisan Guild Marketplace
profile.primary_purpose: Archival documentation of India's living heritage, oral history preservation in native Indian dialects, 360° circular 3D museum exploration, and direct 0% commission craft acquisition.
copy_tone: Authoritative and archival without dry academic detachment
Devotional respect toward generational mastercraftspersons and tribal lineages
Sentence case typography with zero hype words or exclamation marks
Radical economic transparency with zero platform commission highlighted
profile.brand_signature: 60-30-10 Architecture: 60% Charcoal architectural surfaces, 30% Snow White crisp typography, and 10% Sun Orange strictly reserved for interactive clickables, set in modern Outfit and Plus Jakarta Sans with a 24K golden Statue of Unity 3D museum centerpiece.
profile.visual_language: Charcoal, Snow White, and Sun Orange palette with high contrast, ultra-furnished modern typography, eliminating visual clutter and layout displacement.
profile.strategy: Bridge timeless Indian craft wisdom and multimodal AI authentication while eradicating middlemen commissions and fake industrial mass-replications.
profile.style_classification: Living Monumental Heritage / Modern High-Contrast Minimalist

layout.density: Quiet and airy with generous negative space around high-resolution photographic masterworks.
layout.section_rhythm: Alternating subtle contrast between deep charcoal surfaces (#121214) and elevated architectural surfaces (#1A1A1E) separated by 1px hairline borders (#2C2C34).

insights: Strict 60-30-10 color allocation: 60% Charcoal, 30% Snow White, 10% Sun Orange (clickables only)
Cool, furnished, contemporary typography utilizing Outfit for titles and Plus Jakarta Sans for body
Colors derived in perceptual OKLCH space to guarantee WCAG 2.1 AA 4.5:1 text contrast

prohibitions: Never use Sun Orange on non-clickable text, badges, or borders
Never use ungrounded AI glow halos or looping pulse animations
Never use vertical layout shifts on scroll that cause text clustering

families.editorial: Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: JetBrains Mono, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

hierarchy.casing_rule: Sentence case everywhere for labels, badges, and headers. Reserve all-caps strictly for genuine acronyms (GI, UPI, INR, SHA-256).
hierarchy.numbers_rule: Tabular figures (tabular-nums font-mono) for currency amounts (₹), timestamps, chapter bookmarks, and coordinates.

surfaces.materials: Rich teakwood texture, matte paper grain, polished cold silver metal inlays.
